name: Kaminoyama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kaminoyama city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised letter M with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Kaminoyama, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 January 1975; the emblem dates from 1 May 1955.

features.role: Kaminoyama city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter M with a pointed top
